item.chapter_label: The night sky: Moon and calendars
item.stem:
The diagram shows Earth and the Moon. Sonia sketches the Moon on several nights and sees the bright part change shape.

Which statement correctly says what a Moon phase is?

options.A: A phase is a change in the bright part of the Moon seen from Earth; the Moon does not emit its own light.
options.B: A phase means the Moon itself is swelling and shrinking in size.
options.C: A phase is the Moon giving off more or less of its own light.
options.D: A phase is only the night side of Earth, so the bright part we see is the Moon's unlit half.
